'''Orlax''' were venomous<ref>The [[Pocket Orlax]] was described as a non-venomous version of the Orlax, meaning the Orlax must be naturally venomous.</ref> [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] predators native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Being [[Eye/Legends|four-eyed]] creatures, they are able to keep multiple targets in sharp focus at one time. The orlax attack their prey with great speed, leaving few survivors.<ref name="Codex" />
